house_registration.matrix: EN = [[cos p, sin p],[sin p, -cos p]] . (plan x, plan y) + t (plan is mirror-handed to EN)
house_registration.distance_source: Permit A1-3 有效採光範圍檢討表 D values (13 windows/doors)

site_plan_registration.method: least squares on matched lines: lot frontage vs e-map lane edge, private-road edges vs e-map lane edges, NE lot line vs No.21 wall

alignment.limitation: Site plan and e-map are not survey data; expect about 0.3-1 m absolute error. Building dimensions are untouched (rigid placement only).
